title: integration.delivery_requested.v1
description: An event is to be delivered to a tenant's endpoint. A separate fact from the event it carries, so that delivery can be retried, inspected and given up on without anything happening to the original.

source_event_id.description: The event to deliver. The dispatcher reads it rather than being handed a copy, so a payload cannot be delivered that differs from the one that was recorded.

source_event_type.description: Its type, so a destination that subscribes to a subset can be filtered without reading the event.
